from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

sizes = [16, 32, 48]
out_dir = r'c:\Users\victo\WebProjects\Hacker-Portfolio'

for sz in sizes:
    img = Image.new('RGBA', (sz, sz), (9, 11, 10, 255))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    try:
        font = ImageFont.truetype('consola.ttf', int(sz * 0.5))
    except Exception:
        font = ImageFont.load_default()
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), 'VR', font=font)
    tw, th = bbox[2] - bbox[0], bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    x = (sz - tw) // 2 - bbox[0]
    y = (sz - th) // 2 - bbox[1]
    draw.text((x, y), 'VR', fill=(32, 239, 79, 255), font=font)
    img.save(os.path.join(out_dir, f'favicon-{sz}.png'))

# Also save as favicon.ico (multi-size)
imgs = [Image.open(os.path.join(out_dir, f'favicon-{sz}.png')) for sz in sizes]
imgs[0].save(os.path.join(out_dir, 'favicon.ico'), format='ICO', sizes=[(sz, sz) for sz in sizes], append_images=imgs[1:])

print('OK - generated favicon.ico and PNGs')
"
